boundaries.cleanup: transient audio and mutation/scene commit including destruction/free; nested in complete_step
boundaries.complete_step: starts/hook/fixed/synchronization/physics/events/update/animation/late/commit/destructors/transient cleanup; excludes event pumping, render and recorder storage
boundaries.legacy_frame: historical partial metric; absent from schema v2; not equivalent to complete_step
boundaries.narrow_phase: changed geometry, serial support reduction and subscribed events; nested in physics
boundaries.physics: transform synchronization, broad/narrow phase, support reduction, forces, solve, movement and cache publication; nested in complete_step
boundaries.render: independent render calls after cleanup; not nested in complete_step
boundaries.resolve_collisions: contact solving and sleep reduction; nested in physics
boundaries.scene_transition: selected request preparation through replacement/clear publication; nested in cleanup

resolved_parameters.seed_policy: deterministic velocity/pattern phase; seed zero preserves historical layouts
